title: Mana
wikitext:
[[Image:Mana Orb.png|thumb|upright|The Player's Mana Orb, if filled.]]
[[Image:Life Mana Orb Reserved.png|thumb|upright|The Player's Mana Orb, if all mana was reserved]]

'''Mana''' is a resource most commonly used to pay for [[skill]] [[cost]]s. For the player it is shown as a blue orb in the lower right of the screen.

__TOC__

==Mechanics==  
Every [[Character Classes|class]] starts with 40 mana and has the following stats:
{{#cargo_query:
|tables = generic_stats
|fields = stat_text
|where = name="Character" AND id LIKE "%mana%" AND value > 0
|format=ul
}}

Every two points of [[Intelligence]] grants +1 mana.<ref name="GameMechanics" />

{{psl|Blood Magic}} sets your maximum mana to 0. The {{c|mod|when on Low Mana}} and {{c|mod|when on Full Mana}} modifiers are not triggered with 0/0 mana.<ref name="UndefinedMana" />

A character is on [[Low Mana]] when the current percentage of mana is less than or equal to 50% of the maximum.

Mana is considered ''spent'' (for effects like {{il|Kitava's Thirst}}) when used to pay skill [[cost]]s and for [[Arcane Cloak]]'s effect. It is not considered spent when [[loss|lost]] to damage (e.g. with {{psl|Mind over Matter}}) or other effects.<ref name="ManaSPent" />

[[Minion]]s (and monsters) possess mana, but generally have skills that cost nothing, and accordingly do not need to be provided mana recovery.<ref>https://imgur.com/a/khRikeP</ref><ref>https://imgur.com/a/0zUMx7M</ref>

==Calculation==
Total maximum mana can be calculated with the following formula: 

{{math|formula=
\begin{align}
\text{Mana}_{\text{total} } = & \left(34 + \text{Level}_{\text{Character} } \times \text{Mana per level} + \frac{\text{Intelligence} }{2} + \sum_{i=1}^{a} \text{added Mana} \right) \times \\
& \left( 1 + \sum_{j=1}^{b} \text{increased Mana}_{j} - \sum_{k=1}^{c} \text{reduced Mana}_{k} \right) \times \\
& \prod_{l=1}^{d} (1 + \text{more Mana}_{l}) \times \prod_{m=1}^{e} (1 - \text{less Mana}_{m})
\end{align}
}}

Flat mana bonuses are added directly to the base mana ({{c|mod|+X to maximum Mana}}). Percent-based modifiers apply to flat mana bonuses, as well as base mana and mana from [[Intelligence]] ({{c|mod|+X% increased maximum Mana}}). See [[modifiers]].

==Mana loss==
'''Mana''' can be [[loss|lost]] in the following ways:
* By ''spending'' it, on [[skill]] [[cost]]s or [[Arcane Cloak]]'s effect. Skills generally have a base [[mana cost]] which is modified by mana multipliers on linked [[support gems]]. The rate of mana use is also affected by [[cast speed]], [[attack speed]], and [[action speed]]. 
* By [[mana reservation|reserving mana]]. Certain skills reserve, i.e. make unusable, large amounts of mana in exchange for permanent [[buffs]], [[auras]], or [[curses]] acting as auras. This is not spending Mana.
* By making it take damage, e.g. with {{psl|Mind Over Matter}} or {{il|Mind of the Council}}. 
* By various effects that cause direct mana [[loss]], such as {{il|Apep's Rage}}, [[Mana Burn]], or {{il|Temporal Rift}} rewinding to a lower value. 

==Mana recovery==
'''Mana''' may be [[recovery|recovered]] in the following ways:
* [[Mana Flask|Mana]] and [[Hybrid Flasks]]
* [[Mana Regeneration]]
* [[Mana Leech]]
* [[Mana Gained on Hit]]
* [[Mana Gained on Kill]]
* [[Mana Gained on Block]]
* [[Recoup]]
* {{il|Temporal Rift}}
* [[Portal|Returning]] to [[town]] or the [[hideout]] (except in [[Ruthless mode]], which requires you to interact with certain NPCs)

==Gems==
===Skill gems===
{{Query stat related skill gems
|type=active
|where=skill.stat_text LIKE "%maximum_mana%" 
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%current_mana%" 
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%your_mana%"
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%reserved_mana%"
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%reserved_maximum_mana%"
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%mana_per_second%"
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%mana_regen%"
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%when%spend%mana%"
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%mana%spent%"
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%leech%mana"
}}

===Support Gems===
{{Query stat related skill gems
|type=support
|where=skill.stat_text LIKE "%maximum_mana%" 
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%current_mana%" 
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%your_mana%"
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%reserved_mana%"
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%reserved_maximum_mana%"
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%mana_per_second%"
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%mana_regen%"
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%when%spend%mana%"
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%mana%spent%"
OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%leech%mana"
}}

==Mana on Equipment==
===Modifiers===
====Flat maximum mana====
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%base_maximum_mana%"
|spawn_weights=1
|generation_type=1
|domain=1
|q_orderBy=mods.domain ASC, mods.generation_type ASC, mods.id ASC, mods.required_level ASC
}}
====Percentage maximum mana====
=====Regular=====
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%maximum_mana_+\%%"
    AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%elder%"
    AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%shaper%"
|spawn_weights=1
|generation_type=1
|domain=1
|q_orderBy=mods.domain ASC, mods.generation_type ASC, mods.id ASC, mods.required_level ASC
}}
=====Shaper/Elder=====
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%maximum_mana_+\%%"
    AND (
        mod_spawn_weights.tag LIKE "%elder%"
        OR mod_spawn_weights.tag LIKE "%shaper%"
    )
|spawn_weights=1
|generation_type=1
|domain=1
|q_orderBy=mods.domain ASC, mods.generation_type ASC, mods.id ASC, mods.required_level ASC
}}
====Other====
There are several [[Crafting Bench]] modifier that can craft mana on gear.

In addition, {{c|magic|+X to maximum Mana}} can be guaranteed on [[Body Armour]], [[Helmets]], [[Gloves]], and [[Boots]] through the use of [[Essence of Misery]] with a range of {{c|magic|+55 to 77}}.

===Base items===
{{Drop enabled base item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
    item_stats.id LIKE "%maximum_mana%"
|level=1
|stat=1
|large=1
}}

===Unique items===
====Flat maximum mana====
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id LIKE "%base_maximum_mana%"
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=Mana
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=base_maximum_mana
|stat_column1_stat2_id=base_maximum_mana_per_green_socket_on_item
}}
====Percentage maximum mana====
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id = "maximum_mana_+%"
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=Mana
|stat_column1_format=%s%%
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=maximum_mana_+%
}}
====Other====
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
    item_stats.id LIKE "%mana%"
    AND item_stats.id != "maximum_mana_+%"
    AND item_stats.id != "attacks_use_life_in_place_of_mana"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%base_maximum_mana%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%mana_regen%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%mana_recharge%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%mana_cost%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%mana_reserv%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%mana_leech%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%gained_on_kill%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%gained_on_enemy_death%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%gain_per_target%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%low_mana%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%full_mana%"
|level=1
|stat=1
|large=1
}}

==Passive skills==
There are [[passive skill]]s that grant mana bonuses.

===Increased maximum mana===
These passive skills grant increased maximum mana.
{{Query base passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id = "maximum_mana_+%"
}}

===Base maximum mana===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id = "base_maximum_mana"
}}

===Mana regeneration rate===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id = "mana_regeneration_rate_+%"
}}

===Mana cost reduction===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id = "base_mana_cost_-%"
}}

{{see also|Reservation#Related passive skills}}

  AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT IN ("maximum_mana_+%", "base_maximum_mana", "mana_regeneration_rate_+%", "base_mana_cost_-%", "base_mana_reservation_+%", "mortal_conviction_mana_reservation_+%_final", "base_mana_leech_from_attack_damage_permyriad", "maximum_mana_leech_rate_%_per_minute", "mana_leech_speed_+%", "mana_gain_per_target", "base_mana_gained_on_enemy_death")
AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%brequel%"
}}

{{Query ascendancy passive skills

}}

===Keystones===
{{Query keystone passive skills

}}

===Passive masteries===
{{Query masteries|where=mastery_effects.stat_text_raw LIKE "%Mana%"}}

===Tattoos/Runegrafts===
{{Drop enabled item table
|tables = tattoos
|join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID
|where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency"
  AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL
  AND items.description LIKE "%mana%"
|large=1
|description=1
}}

}}

}}
